initialExam.title: NICL AO 2026 (National Insurance Company)
initialExam.description: NICL Administrative Officer recruitment for generalist and specialist AO posts in National Insurance Company, one of India's oldest general insurance companies.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduate from a recognized university with 60% marks
initialExam.qualifications: Graduation in any discipline with minimum 60%
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200 marks + Descriptive 30 marks. Interview: 30 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Administrative Officer (Scale I) in NICL across India
initialExam.careerGrowth: AO (Scale I) → Manager (Scale II) → Sr Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM → CMD.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit nationalinsurance.nic.co.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, NPS, Vehicle/Housing Loan, Gratuity
